svg.title: Index Translator server components, engines
svg.desc: The app builds the chat or document prompt and asks the translation engine for a generation. The engine owns a worker thread, which loads the model through the bindings file and calls libllama. The chat prompt is written by the bindings, not by the templates. The speech engine owns its own worker thread, which calls libaudiocpp through its bindings and reads WAV samples through wav.ts. The two engines share nothing but the process. a translation: src/app.ts → src/llama.ts → src/llama-worker.ts → src/llama-ffi.ts → libllama. reading aloud: src/app.ts → src/speech.ts → src/speech-worker.ts → src/audiocpp-ffi.ts → libaudiocpp.
